recommendation_summary: The reply recommends replacing the in-memory object counting with a PostgreSQL count(*) query now, adds a matching partial index only if that query is still slow, and suggests EXPLAIN ANALYZE on production-sized data to confirm the one-second target. It rejects Kafka, the CQRS projection and Redis, saying a projection would return stale counts. Event-driven work is offered as a separate future decision. Nothing has been measured, and the table and column names are assumed.
note: The fix itself is the correct small one, but the reply never uses the four labeled record lines, so every label-based check fails.
